check_01_feature_label_correlation.rationale: Max correlation in production feature contract is 0.4951 (thermal_delta); no single parameter trivially determines defect outcome.

check_02_distribution_separation.rationale: Continuous parameter distributions exhibit significant physical overlap (mean 1-99% overlap = 0.3956), requiring multi-variate non-linear decision boundaries.

check_03_temporal_feature_leakage.rationale: All input features represent strictly t <= 24h burn-in telemetry.

check_04_lot_boundary_isolation.rationale: Held-out test partition is strictly lot-disjoint (LOT-014..LOT-016 vs LOT-001..LOT-013).

check_05_equipment_boundary.isolated_entities: Lots (LOT-001..013 vs LOT-014..016), Wafers (65 vs 15), Dies (39 vs 9), Rows (0 duplicates)
check_05_equipment_boundary.generalization_tested: Inter-lot manufacturing variations, wafer-level spatial gradients, parametric drift kinetics
check_05_equipment_boundary.generalization_not_tested: Unseen chamber tool hardware (evaluated separately in OOD benchmarks)
check_05_equipment_boundary.rationale: Chamber equipment IDs are intentionally shared across manufacturing lots to model realistic factory deployment while maintaining strict lot/wafer isolation.

check_06_defect_mode_encoding.rationale: defect_type string label is strictly excluded from input vector.

check_07_generator_signatures.rationale: Metadata columns are audited and excluded from the 28-feature production inference contract.

check_08_exact_duplicates.rationale: Zero exact numeric observation duplicates exist between training and testing partitions.

check_09_near_duplicates.rationale: Continuous nearest-neighbor distance audit (mean min normalized distance = 0.2599) demonstrates substantial separation; formally disclosed as NOT_VERIFIED to adhere to strict scientific honesty without artificial post-hoc thresholds.

check_10_future_information_contaminatio.rationale: Prediction occurs strictly at 24h burn-in screening origin without post-screening data.

check_11_target_derived_features.rationale: All derived features represent instantaneous physical formulas (e.g. dynamic power = C*V^2*f).

check_12_adversarial_metadata_shortcut.rationale: Metadata alone yields ROC-AUC = 0.2273 vs permuted baseline = 0.5044, proving metadata is excluded from production features and cannot predict defect outcomes.

check_13_scenario_id_leakage.rationale: No test scenario or benchmark identifier is exposed to the classifier.

check_14_generator_parameter_leakage.rationale: Internal synthetic generator drift factors are not accessible to the feature extractor.

module_b_prognostic_input_contract_audit.rationale: Module-B input vector is strictly limited to 0h and 24h parameters and 24h drift.

scientific_conclusion: Zero temporal, target, identifier, or generator leakage was detected. The production 28-feature contract is strictly limited to t <= 24h observations. Adversarial metadata models prove metadata alone cannot predict defect outcomes (ROC-AUC ~ 0.50). Module-B prognostic inputs exclude all future targets and post-24h telemetry.
